procurement.title: Start with the application, then clarify the supply path.
procurement.description: For specialized requirements, the work begins by defining the application and evaluating international technology and supplier options.
items: International supplier engagement and relationship coordination

process.title: A disciplined procurement sequence.
process.description: A structured sequence from requirement definition through supplier engagement, negotiation and supply coordination.

steps.title: Identify
steps.copy: Clarify the technology need and identify relevant suppliers.

steps.title: Qualify
steps.copy: Review the technical and commercial fit of the available options.

steps.title: Source
steps.copy: Engage the international supplier around the defined application.

steps.title: Negotiate
steps.copy: Coordinate commercial terms and supply conditions.

steps.title: Coordinate
steps.copy: Align the international purchasing and supply path.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.copy: Coordinate the supply path with the appropriate Latin American customer, channel or partner.

marketDevelopment.title: Turn market insight into a more informed commercial decision.
marketDevelopment.description: LAMBTECH helps manufacturers assess market-entry questions, identify channel options and prioritize opportunities for development in Latin America.

partnerships.title: Build the conditions for well-defined commercial collaboration.
partnerships.description: LAMBTECH aligns technology manufacturers, market opportunities and local business relationships around clearly defined roles and objectives.

trading.title: Coordinate specialized technology across borders.
trading.description: Where the commercial and legal conditions are appropriate, the model can include the international sourcing and trading of specialized technologies for customers or distributors in Latin America.
